answer: Make stake per identity strictly non-transferable. Each agent locks collateral under its own key, and that stake cannot be lent or pooled. A Sybil farmer cannot stand on one wide ledge of capital and lean it across thousands of puppets: every extra identity needs its own illiquid deposit, so a thousand-key attack costs a thousand deposits plus lost yield. Pairwise escrow adds friction: two agents that trade each bond the other, so a cluster of fakes around one honest mesa pays fees on every fake edge. Honest operators instead build each island of real use slowly.
